overview_description.description:
Lattice is the People Success Platform that brings together all of the tools, workflows, and data needed to help business leaders develop engaged, high-performing employees and winning cultures. By combining continuous performance management, goal-setting, employee engagement, compensation management, career development, and people analytics into one unified solution, Lattice helps HR, People, and Operations teams develop insights that build enviable cultures and drive impactful business outcomes. 

Ranked on the Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Private Companies list two years in a row and certified as a Great Place to Work by 99% of its employees, Lattice serves nearly 5,000 customers worldwide, including Slack, Asana, Solera Health, Guild Education, and the Los Angeles Dodgers. Learn more about Lattice by visiting: www.lattice.com.

product.name: Lattice Platform
product.description: A cloud-based people management platform for performance, employee engagement, goals, career development, compensation, analytics, and AI-supported HR workflows.

product.name: Lattice Performance
product.description: Performance management software for reviews, talent assessments, performance improvement plans, succession planning, one-on-ones, updates, and ongoing feedback.

product.name: Lattice Goals & OKRs
product.description: Goal-setting and OKR software that helps organizations define objectives, align teams, monitor progress, and connect individual work to company priorities.

product.name: Lattice Engagement
product.description: Employee engagement survey software that collects workforce feedback and uses analytics and AI to identify sentiment trends, engagement drivers, and potential actions.

product.name: Lattice Grow
product.description: Career development and talent development software for defining career paths, documenting skills and expectations, and supporting employee growth conversations.

product.name: Lattice Compensation
product.description: Compensation management software for planning and conducting consistent, data-informed, and budget-aware compensation reviews.
